Row.Text: Lorenzo de' Medici, il Magnifico: banker, poet, diplomat, and the man who kept Italy at peace for twelve years and Florence full of workshops.

+3 [icon:YIELD_GOLD] Gold and +1 [icon:YIELD_HAPPINESS] Happiness for each Great Work in a Settlement. +1 [icon:YIELD_CULTURE] Culture and +1 [icon:YIELD_SCIENCE] Science in all Settlements, and +20% [icon:YIELD_PRODUCTION] Production towards Wonders. Trade Route income is increased by 50%, you have +1 Trade Route capacity and +3 [icon:YIELD_GOLD] Gold for each Trade Route, and Buildings cost 15% less [icon:YIELD_GOLD] Gold to purchase.
Lorenzo judges a court by what its artists have made. He admires leaders who hold many Great Works, and has little to say to those who hold none.
How beautiful is youth, that flies from us so fast. Let who will be glad: of tomorrow there is no certainty.
